threads.body: [General] This method has a production caller: `HttpClientAttributesExtractorBuilder.java:39` installs `HttpClientRequestResendCount::getAndIncrement` as the default callback, which `HttpClientAttributesExtractor.onStart()` invokes to record resend counts. Its package visibility is therefore needed by production code, not just tests. Please remove this comment.

replies.body: Removed the misleading comment in 6ebc6612a7d294b6998bcd8d9d7ecd5336d0664f. The method and its visibility are unchanged.
